homePage.heroText: We bring the right people and their expertise together. So smaller organisations working on social and human causes can put technology to good use — without an in-house development team.
homePage.missionLead: People with meaningful social ideas want to make a positive difference. Technology could help them — yet they often lack the knowledge, resources and access to the right support.
homePage.missionText: At the same time, experienced professionals want to put their skills to meaningful use and make a greater difference. Here to Help brings these two worlds together: initiatives gain help to get started, while professionals see the value of their work and gain new perspectives.
homePage.projectsThemes: Family life. Real connections. Guidance. Digital media.
homePage.projectsText: We are looking for people to contribute to our own projects through advice, development, fresh perspectives and early testing.

homePage.missionResponsibility: We want to use technology to help people. That also means standing up to scams, manipulative apps and unfair business models — through awareness and responsibly designed solutions.

joinPage.title: Good ideas become reality together.
joinPage.text: We are looking for people who would like to work on our own projects. Whether you advise, develop, design or understand a need first-hand, your contribution can move the next idea forward.
joinPage.fundingModel: We are preparing to establish an association. Commissioned work, sponsors, grants and voluntary support are intended to fund project work and operations. Surpluses can also help fund social initiatives and projects in their early stages.
joinPage.fairPay: Our aim is fair, market-based remuneration for project work. Payment and funding are agreed before work begins. Voluntary contributions remain welcome. The board decides how funding is allocated, including between projects, within the budget and any restrictions on designated funds.
joinPage.fundingNotice: The legal structure, tax status and contribution terms are still being clarified. We currently accept no payments through this website and make no claims about tax deductibility.

aboutPage.title: Bringing the right people together.
aboutPage.text: Here to Help connects people, expertise and meaningful initiatives. Our aim is to make technology useful for smaller organisations working on social and human causes.
aboutPage.storyQuestion: The motivation for Here to Help comes from personal encounters with people building social initiatives and wanting to make the world a little better. Technology is everywhere. Yet the knowledge to use it well and access to professional support are often missing — especially when budgets are small.
aboutPage.storyApproach: Here to Help aims to bring these two worlds together. People working on social causes gain help to get started that would otherwise be hard to access. Professionals can contribute their skills meaningfully, keep learning and gain new perspectives through different lived experiences. Together, we look for solutions that are actually needed — pragmatic, simple and good.
aboutPage.storyProjects: We pursue our own projects and invite interested people to contribute their skills and experience. We also offer commissioned services: rapid prototyping, AI consulting, architecture and concept reviews, development, feasibility assessments, optimisation and security testing.
aboutPage.legalStatus: Here to Help is exploring setting up an association with a public-benefit purpose. The legal structure and tax treatment of revenue and grants are still being clarified.
aboutPage.funding: Commissioned work, sponsors and grants are intended to fund market-based remuneration for project work and operations. Surpluses remain with the association and can support social initiatives and projects in their early stages. The board allocates funds within the budget and any applicable restrictions.
aboutPage.transparency: We share what is settled and explain what is still open. Trust grows from clear expectations.
aboutPage.storyExperts: On the other side are skilled professionals who have gained years of experience at service providers and large companies. Some find little room to shape things in their daily work. They want to use their knowledge, make a difference and see who their work actually helps.
aboutPage.storyResponsibility: Another motivation is concern about technology being used for scams, manipulative apps and exploitative business models. We want to help people recognise these risks and use technology on their own terms. Our projects aim to show how digital possibilities can be used fairly and responsibly.

utilityPages.privacyText: This website introduces Here to Help and its projects. It uses no accounts, analytics tools or application storage.
utilityPages.browserText: The website stores no entries in cookies, localStorage or a database. Filters, navigation and forms use only temporary state in the open browser window.

utilityPages.hostingText: When you load a website, the hosting provider may process connection data needed to serve it. The specific provider, responsible operator and contact details must be added before publication. External links may open services with their own privacy policies.
utilityPages.publishingText: Details of the legally responsible operator and hosting are still pending. This transparency page does not replace a final, reviewed privacy policy.

servicesPage.title: Practical. Simple. Well done.
